rules.statement: The judgment-debtor's title to the property seized in execution must arise before the action under section 247 can be brought, and this title is not considered as of a later date than the seizure.
rules.supporting_quote: "No reason whatever has been urged why the plaintiff in this form of action should be exempt from the fundamental rule, that an action has to be determined according to the rights of the parties as existing at the date of its' institution. On the contrary, the sequence of the enactments which culminate in the action under section 247 renders it impossible to avoid the conclusion that the rights of the creditor as well as of the claimant must be considered as at the date of seizure."
